name: ISS
notes: The baseline. Sea-level air at 14.7 psi; oxygen drifts around a 21 % mean.

name: Orion / transit
notes: Assumed to carry the same cabin air as the ISS. No source on record yet.

name: EVA suit
notes: Pure oxygen at 4.3 psi, as in the challenge text. Gravity depends on where the suit is worn; the lunar surface is used here.

name: Lunar surface habitat
notes: Challenge text: at least 30 % oxygen at 10.2 psi or less. The low end is NASA's exploration atmosphere, 8.2 psia with 34 % oxygen.

name: Pressurized rover
notes: Assumed to share the surface habitat's atmosphere so crews can move between them. Range to confirm.

name: Mars surface habitat
notes: No Mars cabin atmosphere has been chosen. Assumed equal to the lunar habitat.
